name: The working landscape
reader_question: How do work, context and review connect?
visual_idea: Three work corridors share a contextual base, meet a review seam and leave a separate reuse route.
why_geometry_helps: Three work corridors share a contextual base, meet a review seam and leave a separate reuse route.
interaction_if_any: Native labelled controls expose the relevant object or consequence; no hover dependency.
false_inference_risk: A continuous corridor could be read as automatic workflow execution; review seam and scope explicitly stop that inference.

what_is_deliberately_not_shown: Detailed chapter text and actual enterprise readiness.
